app.full_title: HSE PYXIS — HSE Inspection & Risk Management

welcome.subtitle: Intelligent platform for HSE inspection and industrial risk management
welcome.description: Probabilistic analysis, Monte Carlo simulation, human risk indicators and cost-benefit assessment — in one unified platform.

step1.title: 📝 Inspection (Data Entry)
step1.caption: Open each symptom: choose the compliance, add the evidence (file) and the note, then save. Then run the AI check with its own button.

step1.choose_matrix: Choose the matrix to apply to this inspection
step1.save_hint: 💡 Each card has its own **Save** button (compliance + evidence + note) and a **Verify with AI** button. This button saves every chosen compliance at once. NC/PC items are analysed in Step 2.
step1.evidence_caption: Upload supporting files (photos, PDFs, reports) for each symptom. A symptom can have both a file and a note.
step1.evidence_search: 🔍 Search for a symptom (by ID or keyword)
step1.evidence_note_placeholder: e.g. photo taken on 2025-01-15, ref. ABC-123
step1.ai_not_configured: 🤖 AI check unavailable: GEMINI_API_KEY is not configured (see app1/.env).
step1.pick_domain_hint: 👆 Choose a domain to display the matching sections.

step1.only_todo: Show only symptoms still to inspect
step1.domain_from_profile: Domain set in the Company profile

step2.title: 📊 QRA Analysis
step2.no_active_matrix: ❌ No active matrix. Go to **Step 1** to choose one.
step2.no_nc_pc: 👉 No NC/PC symptom in the buffer. Go to **Step 1** to fill in the conformities.
step2.phase_a_title: 🅰️ Phase A — Monte Carlo analysis on all NC/PC
step2.phase_a_caption: Quick computation (10,000 iterations) to rank symptoms by risk. Only the 10 riskiest move on to the detailed forms (Phase C).
step2.quick_done: ✅ Analysis complete — {n} symptoms analysed. Top 10 identified.
step2.already_done: ✅ Analysis already done: {n} symptoms in the Top 10.
step2.quick_hint: 💡 Click **Run the quick analysis** to start. This may take a few seconds.
step2.run_phase_a_first: 👉 Run the Phase A analysis to see the Top 10.
step2.forms_below: 👉 The detailed forms appear below for each Top 10 symptom.
step2.phase_c_caption: Fill in the forms below for each symptom. Each form is independent.
step2.env_step1_caption: Start by defining the site location on the map.
step2.env_step2_caption: Fetch current weather based on location.
step2.env_step3_caption: Select the substance and leak parameters.
step2.env_step4_caption: Visualize the impact zone on the map.
step2.env_curve_caption: Visualise how the concentration decreases with distance for the substance and scenario entered above.
step2.env_weather_caption: Fetches wind speed/direction, temperature, pressure and humidity from OpenWeather.
step2.env_map_caption: Estimated impact zone on OpenStreetMap background (Leaflet).
step2.env_map_no_data: ⚠️ Fill in the leak parameters to display the map.
step2.env_loc_search_placeholder: e.g. Algiers, Hassi Messaoud, Skikda Refinery...
step2.env_loc_gps_help: Your position will be detected automatically by the browser (requires GPS permission).
step2.env_loc_gps_hint: 💡 In browser: allow location in the address bar.
step2.chem_source_default: ⚠️ Source: internal default values (TLV or conservative value)
step2.form_saved: ✅ Form for {id} saved to the buffer.
step2.final_caption: Once all forms are filled in, click here to run the final Monte Carlo analysis (100,000 iterations) + PLL/FAR/LIRA + cost-benefit + dispersion for each Top 10 symptom.
step2.goto_step3: 👉 Go to **Step 3** (sidebar) to see the results.

step3.title: 📈 Results & Classification
step3.batch_not_run: 👉 The batch analysis has not been run yet. Go to **Step 2** (sidebar) to run it.
step3.no_results: ⚠️ No results in the database for this inspection.
step3.no_cost_benefit: ⚠️ No cost-benefit result. Check that the asset target is ticked and that the action cost has been entered and saved for at least one symptom.
step3.matrix_caption: Positioning of NC/PC symptoms by (Severity × Probability) — matrix “{site}”
step3.human_empty: No human risk result. This covers symptoms ticked as “human target” with a number of exposed people filled in.
step3.lira_thresholds: Indicative LIRA thresholds: > {high}/yr = unacceptable · ≤ {low}/yr = negligible · in between = ALARP zone.
step3.cb_caption: ⚠️ Decision support — the benefit/cost ratio does not replace HSE judgement, it supports it.

step4.unavailable: ℹ️ The report module (`ui/pages/report.py`) is not present in this project. Add it to enable this step.
step4.title: 📄 Final Report
step4.caption: Generates a professional inspection report from the Step 2/3 results, using a language model (Gemini).
step4.not_configured_body: Add `GEMINI_API_KEY=...` to a `.env` file at the project root (see `.env.example`), then restart the app.
step4.custom_instructions_placeholder: e.g. focus on the environmental target
step4.disclaimer: ⚠️ AI-generated report — to be validated by an HSE manager before distribution.
step4.batch_required: 👉 Run the **final analysis** in Step 2 first for a report based on the Monte Carlo results.
step4.no_data: ⚠️ No inspection data found to generate a report.
step4.tpl_help: Upload your company's report template: the AI writes the report following its headings, order and table columns. Word (.docx) is recommended: styles, headers/footers and logo are preserved. Optional: put `{{REPORT_BODY}}` where the content should start; everything before it (cover page, contents) is kept, and everything after it is treated as a structure sample and replaced (add `{{END_REPORT_BODY}}` to keep the ending: signatures, annexes). Variables replaced: `{{site}}` `{{inspection_id}}` `{{date}}` `{{inspector}}` `{{reviewer}}` `{{version}}` `{{ref}}` `{{title}}`.
step4.tpl_save_btn: 💾 Save this template for future inspections
step4.tpl_required: 👆 Upload or pick a template to enable generation.
step4.tpl_empty: No usable text found in this template (scanned PDF?). Use a .docx or a PDF that contains text.
step4.tpl_detected: Structure detected in the template ({n} headings)
step4.tpl_no_headings: No headings detected: the AI will follow the structure of the template text.
step4.tpl_marker_found: ✅ {{REPORT_BODY}} marker found: what precedes it is kept; what follows it (structure sample) is replaced by the report.
step4.tpl_marker_missing: ℹ️ No {{REPORT_BODY}} marker: the whole template body will be replaced by the report (styles, headers and footers kept).
step4.tpl_non_docx_note: ℹ️ This format is used as a structure guide; the generated Word file will use a standard layout. To reuse your exact branding, provide a .docx.
step4.top_n_note: The report will cover the {n} highest-risk symptoms (all are listed).

step5.custom_instructions_caption: Format, methodology, tone... AI will respect these.
